LanguageData.HE_Roma_Standard.label: legion standard
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Standard.description: A red standard of the legions on a tall pole, crowned with a golden eagle. Soldiers stand straighter when they see it.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Aqueduct.label: aqueduct span
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Aqueduct.description: A span of arched aqueduct in pale stone, carrying a channel of running water. Impressive, beautiful and very heavy.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Brazier.label: legion brazier
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Brazier.description: A bronze brazier on iron legs. It lights the camp at night and warms the hands of the watch.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_ScutumDisplay.label: scutum display
LanguageData.HE_Roma_ScutumDisplay.description: A curved legionary shield painted with golden wings, hung on a stand. Veterans touch it for luck before a battle.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Statue.label: forum statue
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Statue.description: A marble statue of a toga-clad citizen raising a golden laurel. It makes any square feel like a forum.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Triclinium.label: triclinium table
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Triclinium.description: A low marble dining table covered with a red cloth, set for wine, olives and long conversations.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Thermae.label: thermae pool
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Thermae.description: A heated marble bathing pool. Colonists come here to soak, talk and let their worries drift away.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Scorpio_Gun.label: scorpio
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Scorpio_Gun.description: The turning top of the scorpio.
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Scorpio.label: scorpio
LanguageData.HE_Roma_Scorpio.description: A torsion bolt thrower on a stone platform. Twisted sinew springs send a heavy iron-tipped bolt through a shield and the man behind it. It shoots one bolt at a time, slowly, but very far and very hard. Wood is cut into new bolts: one log makes two.
